messages:
rafael: Heads-up — two things: (1) small SLA wording change approved by legal (no service-impact, just clearer uptime calc), and (2) we're running an APAC failover drill + short load verification next Tue. Please read and ack.

emily: What changed in the SLA text?

rafael: Minor: we clarified uptime measurement windows (moving from rolling 30d to calendar-month by contract) and added explicit maintenance window exclusions. No change to numerical uptime %. Legal asked us to publish internal note and notify account teams.

jess: OK. When's the drill?

rafael: Tue May 5 2026 22:00-23:15 UTC (that's Wed May 6 07:00-08:15 JST). Scope: simulated AZ drain in ap-northeast-1, failover traffic to ap-southeast-1, and a controlled token-heavy replay to exercise cold KV cache and runtime warmup.

aisha: Expected customer impact?

rafael: No planned customer downtime. You may see elevated latencies and transient 5xxs for canary-affiliated traffic. We'll freeze promotions and pausing automated upgrades during the window.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: "APAC failover drill + SLA note" Tue May 05 22:00-23:15 UTC  invites sent to #eng-sre, #eng-runtime, #support.

emily: Monitoring plan: temp dashboard with p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv-miss, region routing counts. Pager if 5xx > 15% for 4m or p99 > 1.2s for 6m. I'll attach links 45m before.

jess: I'll prepare customer outreach for key enterprise accounts and update status page templates. Also disabling auto-promote 21:30-00:30 UTC that night.

rafael: Runbook snippets and abort commands for quick copy:
```
# stop replay
kubectl scale deploy/replay -n stress --replicas=0
# isolate ap-northeast-1 canary pool
infractl routing set-weight --region ap-northeast-1 --pool canary --weight 0
# force local warmup backoff
infractl kvcache set-retention --pool canary --seconds 600
```

aisha: I'll be on-call and can join the incident channel. Acked.

emily: Acked  will post dashboard links ~45m prior.

jess: :eyes: drafting enterprise note and tagging account leads.

rafael: Also, internal action: ops please publish the SLA wording change summary to #all-hands and attach the legal memo. I put the memo at https://redwood.internal/legal/sla-2026-05.

infra-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-apac-failover-1847654321

rafael: Thanks. React with :white_check_mark: once you've read and there are no conflicts.

emily: :white_check_mark:

jess: :white_check_mark:

aisha: :white_check_mark:
